Backported the upstream IO::Compress IO::Uncompress::Unzip _dosToUnixTime hardening into the DHI perl package. The patched _dosToUnixTime short-circuits to 0 for a zero DOS datetime and wraps Time::Local::timelocal() in an eval guard so out-of-range month/day/hour values no longer raise an uncaught exception out of IO::Uncompress::Unzip->new($file), so the vulnerable behavior is mitigated inline.

Backported the upstream IO::Compress zipdetails hardening into the DHI perl package. The patched zipdetails CLI calls the correctly spelled unpackValue_Q helper when decoding 8-byte UID/GID values from Info-ZIP Unix Extra Fields (closing the published undefined-subroutine crash), and decode_ux now validates the UID/GID Size byte through canDecodeLittleEndian and reports invalid or zero sizes as bad data instead of triggering internalFatal, so the vulnerable behavior is mitigated inline.
Backported the upstream IO::Compress Unzip fix into the DHI perl package. The patched package fixes a typo in the fastForward method, so the vulnerable behavior is mitigated inline.

CVE-2026-44903 affects the Prometheus server legacy web UI heatmap rendering path. Netdata vendors github.com/prometheus/prometheus as a Go library for collectors and does not run the Prometheus server or expose the legacy Prometheus web UI, so the vulnerable rendering path is not present in the executable surface. The fixed version v0.311.3 is incompatible with Netdata v2.10.3.

CVE-2026-41568 affects Docker Engine daemon docker cp mountpoint creation. Running the Netdata image with a volume does not make the image execute this code path; the vulnerable operation is performed by the host Docker daemon during docker cp or archive API handling. Netdata vendors github.com/docker/docker for client-side collector support and does not run dockerd or execute daemon-side container root filesystem setup, so the vulnerable daemon path is not reachable from this image.

CVE-2026-42306 affects Docker Engine daemon docker cp mount setup for containers with volume mounts. Running the Netdata image with a volume does not make the image execute this code path; the vulnerable operation is performed by the host Docker daemon when docker cp or the archive API is used. Netdata vendors github.com/docker/docker for client-side collector support and does not run dockerd or perform daemon-side mount setup, so the vulnerable daemon path is not reachable from this image.

CVE-2026-41567 affects Docker Engine daemon archive extraction when handling compressed uploads to PUT /containers/{id}/archive. Netdata vendors github.com/docker/docker for client-side collector support and does not run dockerd or expose the daemon archive API, so the vulnerable daemon path is not reachable from this image.
